verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API development and testing platform, so spec linting is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no API spec linting, style rules, or governance rule configuration. The only spec-related evidence is OpenAPI import (tags as folders), which is an adjacent feature, not linting.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can lint API specs against configurable style and governance rules
